## **Tasks 2**

1.  Create a New .R file from File \> R Script

    Or type: `Ctrl+ Shift +N` shortcut

2.  Save it as `practice_code.R` in `Week 2` folder

3.  Now practice code from Tasks 3.

4.  Use `Ctrl+Enter` to run the certain line of code or select the line of code to run.

5.  [Click this link](https://docs.posit.co/ide/user/ide/guide/code/execution.html) to learn how to execute code in .R file.
